root_cause: An actual native approved supply run for 2026-10-20 returned an OpenAI candidate outside the strict 900–1500 word range. The unchanged validator correctly rejected it, but the one-shot generation stopped the entire supply workflow even after the previously repaired Notion title contract.
intervention: Permit at most three whole-candidate OpenAI generations on the specific word-count validation failure. Prompt for 1100–1250 words on retry. Never pad, truncate or auto-approve a failing article; preserve the existing strict validator, provider safety controls, and downstream Notion idempotency.
prevention: Deterministic regression tests assert one invalid then valid response, fail-closed after three invalid responses, no retry for unrelated quality failures, and sanitized public aggregate context only.
